typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Time as timestamp,
		Average as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R44 TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R112 TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R180 TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R188 TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R119 TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R52 TEMPERATURE} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R52_TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R44_TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R180_TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R188_TEMPERATURE} as double,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R112_TEMPERATURE} as double,
		Average as double,
		Time as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R119_TEMPERATURE} as double,
		FName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		EtlUser,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R52_TEMPERATURE} = {Pane1-SF_SH3_R52 TEMPERATURE},
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R44_TEMPERATURE} = {Pane1-SF_SH3_R44 TEMPERATURE},
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R180_TEMPERATURE} = {Pane1-SF_SH3_R180 TEMPERATURE},
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R188_TEMPERATURE} = {Pane1-SF_SH3_R188 TEMPERATURE},
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R112_TEMPERATURE} = {Pane1-SF_SH3_R112 TEMPERATURE},
		Average,
		Time,
		{Pane1-SF_SH3_R119_TEMPERATURE} = {Pane1-SF_SH3_R119 TEMPERATURE},
		FName),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
